recommendation.reason: Full speed (59.5 tok/s, 102% of baseline), 4.8 GB VRAM headroom for stability. 32K works but only 2.8 GB headroom — risky under concurrent load.
recommendation.alternative: 32768 if single-user and max context is needed

finding: Zero speed degradation across all tested context sizes. KV cache scales linearly in VRAM (~125 MB per 1K context tokens) but generation throughput is constant at ~60 tok/s. The -c 2048 default was leaving 10 GB of VRAM unused.
